name: Shield AI
summary: Autonomous flight and drone systems for contested environments.
overview: Shield AI builds autonomy software and aircraft for defense applications.

facts.label: Latest disclosed financing
facts.note: Company-announced financing at a $12.7B post-money valuation, alongside $500M of fixed-return preferred equity.

bull_case: Autonomy is increasingly central to defense procurement and platform differentiation.
bear_case: Procurement cycles, export controls, and platform integration create execution risk.

intelligence.description: Shield AI develops autonomy software and aircraft systems intended to operate without GPS, communications or a pilot in contested environments.
company: Shield AI's Hivemind software is designed to enable autonomous decision-making for aircraft and other systems operating in denied environments.
The company pairs the software platform with defense aircraft and a growing set of government and industry relationships.
intelligence.why_it_matters: Shield AI captures the defense-tech shift from individual platforms toward software-defined autonomy. Its commercial proof points matter for a wider cohort of private companies selling AI into national-security budgets.

changed.text: Raised $240M to scale Hivemind Enterprise and autonomy product development.
Announced $1.5B of Series G financing at a $12.7B post-money valuation and an acquisition of Aechelon.

takeaways: Autonomy software is the core strategic asset, not simply the airframe.
Defense procurement timing and program concentration remain material risks.
The 2026 financing substantially increased Shield AI's capital base and valuation.
